rules.statement: The deed conveyed a bare dominium of the land to the trustees of the mosque with a right of usufruct to a one-fourth share, and as there was no grant to the children or an acceptance of the gift by them, they would inherit as on an intestacy and a lease by them would be binding on their heirs.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the deed conveyed a bare dominium of the land to the trustees of the mosque with a right of usufruct to a one-fourth share. Held, further, that as there was no grant to the children or an acceptance of the gift by them they would inherit as on an intestacy and a lease by them would be binding on their heirs."
